column4: DESKTOP START 1440x3294 (the title says 900px; it is a full scrolling page). Built and routed at /play/hilo - HiLoPage mounts the same HiLoGame the casino grid opens, at variant=fullscreen, with HiLoPageSections rendering the column beneath. PARTIAL, and it can be nothing else: the frame draws a CARD game and the rail deals a 0-9999 roll, so the board itself - 3-of-hearts over a deck, King/Ace ghost rails, Skip Card, split Profit Higher / Profit Lower fields, drawn-cards strip - has no rail behind it and was deliberately not skinned over the number game. See status.hilo.tsv for the decision this needs from Casey. ★ CORRECTING THE EARLIER VERDICT ON THIS FRAME: the recorded claim that Start is "INVERTED and would be house-negative if built as drawn" is WRONG, and I checked the arithmetic rather than repeating it. Start's MULTIPLIERS are exactly right for the card it draws, at exactly the 1% edge the live rail runs: face-up 3, Higher-or-Same = 11/13 = 84.62% -> 0.99/0.8462 = 1.17x (frame prints 1.17x), Lower-or-Same = 3/13 = 23.08% -> 0.99/0.2308 = 4.29x (frame prints 4.29x). What is wrong is the two PERCENTAGE labels, 30.77% and 76.92%: those are 4/13 and 10/13, the values for a face-up 10, left over from the Loss variant (9061-9472), which does draw a 10 and is fully self-consistent. So this is a stale-label copy-paste on two text nodes, not an inverted paytable and not a house-negative price. Nothing on the page reproduces either number - the widget computes its own from live config - so no player ever saw them. ADDED 2026-09-24 (skai-gaming 30ded292): chrome now matches at 1440 in a browser (panel 356x621 @x=100, board 922x621 @x=464, gap 8); the board runs 32px short of the frame's 954, which is the GameShell route gutter every routed game carries (same as Dice), not a Hi-Lo-specific gap. Card content stays parked by the 2026-08-25 ruling.

DESKTOP LOSS 1440x3294. Same route, same widget, same card-vs-roll gap as 9061-10499. ★ THIS FRAME IS THE ARITHMETICALLY CLEAN ONE and it independently confirms the design's intended house edge. Read off its own metadata: face-up card 10 of spades (top of the stack, node 9061:9650), Higher or Same 30.77% = 4/13, Lower or Same 76.92% = 10/13, Profit Higher (3.22x) = 0.99/0.3077, Profit Lower (1.29x) = 0.99/0.7692. Every number closes at a 1.00% edge - the SAME edge the live POINTS rail runs (points-game index.ts:5474 multiplier = 99/wc) and the same the client asserts (HiLoGame.tsx HILO_RAIL_EDGE = 0.01). The card design is therefore fully costed and does not need an economics negotiation; only a rail that deals cards. Drawn-cards strip carries 3 (Start Card), then 10, 9, 4, 7, K, A, 2, 5.

Its layer name AND its own rendered breadcrumb both read "Skai > Play > Casino > Scratchers", and it is Hi-Lo: 3-of-hearts over a deck, "King Being The Highest" / "Ace Being The Lowest" ghost cards, Profit Higher (1.17x) / Profit Lower (4.29x), drawn-cards strip with a Start Card chip, and a bet panel whose CTA stack is Bet then "Lower Or Same" then the two odds rows. Verified by rendering the frame, not by trusting the title. Served by the same responsive /play/hilo page rather than a second implementation. Carries the same stale 30.77% / 76.92% labels as the Start frame against a 3 (see 9061-10499). Its game-details card is another leftover - titled "Scratchers" with PLINKO cover art over Hi-Lo body copy. MOBILE BOARD 347x410, the board-only component of the 375 page. ★ THE WORST OF THE FRAME NUMBER DEFECTS and reported rather than built: it prints ONE probability, 53.58%, against BOTH arrows at once - the mint up-chevron and the red down-chevron each read "53.58% Lower or Same" - while still carrying the 1.17x / 4.29x profit pair, which belongs to an 84.62/23.08 split. Two opposite outcomes cannot share a probability, and 53.58% is not a k/13 value at all. None of it is reproduced: the page renders no odds or profit figures and the widget computes its own from live config.
